hunks.baseline: Even though every one of us knew that—including me—the wall of reality standing in our way was high and solid.
hunks.sol: Every one of us knew that, yet reality stood before us like a high, solid wall.

hunks.baseline: Unlike our three thousand allies, who hadn’t had a proper rest, the pursuers closing in by the moment were monsters who didn’t even feel fatigue.
hunks.sol: Our force of some three thousand hadn’t had a proper rest. The pursuers closing in by the moment were monsters that didn’t even feel fatigue.

hunks.baseline: We’d been coming down the mountain without a break for barely two hours when—
hunks.sol: We’d been coming down the mountains without a break for barely two hours when—

hunks.baseline: I’d learned how to fight multiple enemies and how to make snap decisions in all kinds of situations.
hunks.sol: I’d learned how to fight multiple enemies and make snap decisions in all kinds of situations.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s mighty Azure Dragon’s Roar shattered the fear lodged in our allies’ hearts and drove their hesitant feet forward, if only for a moment.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s mighty azure dragon’s roar shattered the fear lodged in our allies’ hearts and hurried their hesitant steps, if only for a moment.

hunks.baseline: The ground-covering dust billowed up behind my advancing feet, forming another cloud—one larger and denser than the cloud surrounding the several hundred enemies.
hunks.sol: Dust billowed up from the ground beneath my feet, forming another cloud—one larger and denser than the cloud surrounding the several hundred enemies.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the swirling sand and dust, the monsters who were neither dead nor alive came into sharp focus.
hunks.sol: Beyond the swirling sand and dust, the monsters who were neither dead nor alive came sharply into view.

hunks.baseline: I tilted up the spear clenched in my hands just as a dazzling streak of light reached the enemy a step ahead of me.
hunks.sol: I angled up the spear clenched in my hands just as a dazzling streak of light reached the enemy a step ahead of me.

hunks.baseline: Shot from the Bow Saint’s fingertips, it swallowed up dozens of monsters charging at the front and vaporized them in an instant.
hunks.sol: Shot from the Bow Saint’s fingertips, it swallowed dozens of monsters charging at the front and vaporized them in an instant.

hunks.baseline: As if to prove my skill advanced with every passing day, everything aligned in an attack without a hair’s breadth of error. It only grazed the enemies—but that was enough.
hunks.sol: As if to prove my skill advanced with every passing day, everything came together without a hair’s breadth of error. The strike only grazed the enemies—but that was enough.

hunks.baseline: A single diagonal sweep split and burst their rotting bodies, spilling blood.
hunks.sol: A single downward-slanting sweep split rotting bodies and sent blood spraying.

hunks.baseline: Monsters and enemies surrounded me on all sides.
hunks.sol: Everywhere I looked, there were monsters. Enemies.

hunks.baseline: At the last chime, I confirmed that nothing else was moving and lifted my head.
hunks.sol: After the last chime, I saw that nothing else was moving and lifted my head.

hunks.baseline: Naturally, I got no answer. I picked up a sword from the one submerged in a pool of foul-smelling blood and added,
hunks.sol: Naturally, I got no answer. I picked up someone’s sword from a pool of foul-smelling blood and added,

hunks.baseline: *Thrust!*
hunks.sol: *Stab.*

hunks.baseline: The pain that had come with the flash of light at the last moment still lingered in his mind, as if an awl were burrowing into his head.
hunks.sol: The pain that had come with the flash of light at the last moment still lingered, as though an awl were digging into his head.

hunks.baseline: What mattered was that Jin Taekyung had made it real—and that was precisely what made that young man, not even thirty yet, so exceptional.
hunks.sol: What mattered was that Jin Taekyung had done it—and that was precisely what made a young man not even thirty yet so exceptional.

hunks.baseline: Unlike Jin Taekyung, his own role was already set. He would never be the star of this stage.
hunks.sol: Unlike Jin Taekyung, his own role was set. He would never be the star of this stage.

hunks.baseline: And the most important task currently before him was nothing more than keeping a thorough watch and reporting back.
hunks.sol: For now, his most important task was to watch them closely and report back.

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao went to find the superior he’d only recently begun serving and reported everything in detail. The Blood Lord listened, then furrowed his brow.
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao went to the superior he’d only recently begun serving and reported everything in detail. The Blood Lord listened, then furrowed his brow.

hunks.baseline: A palm strike flew at him before he could finish.
hunks.sol: A blast of palm force struck before he could finish.

hunks.baseline: Even an ordinary Peak master would have died on the spot if struck by that blow. Ma Sanbao was swept away by the force, yet despite the tremendous impact, he immediately prostrated himself.
hunks.sol: Even a Peak master would have died on the spot from a direct hit. Ma Sanbao was swept away by the force, yet despite the tremendous impact, he immediately prostrated himself.

hunks.baseline: “...My Lord.”
hunks.sol: “…My Lord.”

hunks.baseline: “What, are you finally scared? I suppose you have reason to be. Your Master died the same way, after all.”
hunks.sol: “What, are you finally scared? I suppose you have reason to be. Your master ended up dead like that too.”

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao lowered himself even further.
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao bowed even lower.

hunks.baseline: Unlike his Master, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, Ma hadn’t achieved Great Completion in the White Illusion Jiangshi Art. So his fear of death could only be greater.
hunks.sol: Unlike his master, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, Ma hadn’t achieved Great Completion in the White Illusion Jiangshi Art. His fear of death was all the greater for it.

hunks.baseline: “Shut your mouth. If you want to live even fifteen minutes longer.”
hunks.sol: “Shut your mouth if you want to live another fifteen minutes.”

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord glared down at Ma Sanbao with irritation, but that was the extent of the punishment he could give.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord glared down at Ma Sanbao with irritation, but that was as far as he would go.

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao was a useful expendable in many ways, and the Blood Lord had never intended to kill one of the few subordinates worth keeping.
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao was a useful expendable in many ways, and the Blood Lord had never intended to kill one of his few capable subordinates.

hunks.baseline: Besides, the reason the Blood Lord had threatened Ma so harshly was that he wanted to show off his authority and control in front of someone he disliked.
hunks.sol: He’d threatened Ma so harshly because he wanted to show off his authority and control in front of someone he disliked.

hunks.baseline: Of course, that someone paid no attention to the Blood Lord’s display and remained focused on another matter.
hunks.sol: Of course, that someone paid no attention to his display and remained focused on another matter.

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord answered the Grand Mage’s question, which sounded almost like she’d asked herself.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord answered the Grand Mage’s almost rhetorical question.

hunks.baseline: Ma Sanbao hesitated for a moment. But when he met the Grand Mage’s deeply penetrating gaze, he realized—
hunks.sol: Ma Sanbao hesitated. But when he met the Grand Mage’s fathomless gaze, he realized she already knew.

hunks.baseline: She already saw through everything.
She had guessed what he’d been too afraid to say, worried that his violent superior would scold him even more.
hunks.sol: She had guessed what he’d been too afraid to say for fear of an even harsher rebuke from his violent superior.

hunks.baseline: “It was someone I’d encountered only vaguely, through brief rumors and bits of information, more than a decade ago.”
hunks.sol: “It was someone I’d heard of only vaguely, through brief rumors and scraps of information, more than a decade ago.”

hunks.baseline: The world belonged within the bounds of the Great Nation, and the Great Nation’s imperial family had built a watchtower to observe what lay inside and beyond those bounds.
hunks.sol: All under heaven lay within the borders of the Great Nation. To watch what lay both inside and beyond those borders, the imperial family had built a watchtower.

hunks.baseline: The East Depot—the imperial watchtower.
hunks.sol: That watchtower was the East Depot.

hunks.baseline: And that peerless watchtower, overlooking the world, shared its sights with Dark Heaven through the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: From its commanding view of all under heaven, it had shared what it saw with Dark Heaven through the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: “Though his influence has waned in his conflict with the current Emperor, information still flowed in from all across the realm through the eyes and ears he’d planted everywhere.”
hunks.sol: “Though the East Depot’s influence has waned in its conflict with the current Emperor, all manner of information still flowed in through the eyes and ears it had planted across the realm.”

hunks.baseline: “It isn’t a particularly well-known name, either. He’s a madman, and his past is shrouded in mystery.”
hunks.sol: “It isn’t particularly well known, either. He’s a madman, and his past is shrouded in mystery.”

hunks.baseline: Caught up in the coinciding currents of the times, Great Sir’s existence had gradually been forgotten.
hunks.sol: Caught in those overlapping currents of the times, Great Sir had gradually been forgotten.

hunks.baseline: Listening to the story of this mysterious man, the Grand Mage suddenly found an answer to a question she’d forgotten.
hunks.sol: As she listened to the story of this mysterious man, the Grand Mage suddenly found an answer to a question she’d forgotten.

hunks.baseline: A suspicion close to certainty. At the same time, another question surfaced, and her gaze grew distant.
hunks.sol: It was a suspicion close to certainty. At the same time, another question arose, and her gaze darkened.
